allow: PowerShell($t = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('GH_TOKEN','User'\); if \(-not $t\) { $t = $env:GH_TOKEN }; if \($t\) { try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod https://api.github.com/repos/weeef/garage -Headers @{Authorization="Bearer $t"}; "token ok, push=$\($r.permissions.push\)" } catch { "token invalid: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } } else { 'no token' })

PowerShell(node scripts/publish-mobile.js 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { "$_" }; $t=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('GH_TOKEN','User'\); $h=@{Authorization="Bearer $t"; Accept='application/vnd.github+json'}; try { $pg = Invoke-RestMethod https://api.github.com/repos/weeef/garage/pages -Headers $h; "pages: $\($pg.status\) $\($pg.html_url\) source=$\($pg.source.branch\)" } catch { "pages lookup: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell($t=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('GH_TOKEN','User'\); $h=@{Authorization="Bearer $t"; Accept='application/vnd.github+json'}; try { $pg = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post https://api.github.com/repos/weeef/garage/pages -Headers $h -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{"source":{"branch":"gh-pages","path":"/"}}'; "enabled: $\($pg.html_url\) $\($pg.status\)" } catch { "enable failed: $\($_.Exception.Message\) $\($_.ErrorDetails.Message\)" })
